Chapter 620: Chapter 41 Miniature Universe (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 620: Chapter 41 Miniature Universe (Please Subscribe)

“`

“This… This means he made it through?”

“`

“`

Stone Statue Shen Ji glanced at the starting position on the Third Layer of the Black Tower, then at the ‘finish line’ where Lin Yuan now stood, finally realizing something.

“`

...

“`

“How could it be so fast?”

“`

“`

Stone Statue Shen Ji found it hard to believe. He had long speculated that Lin Yuan must have had a breakthrough, which is why he dared to continue challenging the Third Layer of the Black Tower.

“`

“`

After all, the test of the Third Layer, unlike the First and Second Layers, required the challenger to withstand omnipresent pressure.

“`

“`

This omnipresent pressure could be used to temper oneself, but the Third Layer? The test was the occupation of Spatial Layers, a strict criterion: you can or you can’t.

“`

“`

So when Lin Yuan returned, Stone Statue Shen Ji was certain that an important breakthrough had occurred.

“`

“`

If Lin Yuan was treading water strength-wise, there would’ve been no point in coming back.

“`

“`

But this breakthrough… it’s terrifying.

“`

“`

Even though Stone Statue Shen Ji had been through the unending glory of the Magic Jade Tower, Lin Yuan’s tower-conquering speed still shocked him.

“`

“`

Stone Statue Shen Ji could be sure that this sliver of Spirit Will that Lin Yuan had sent was still at Ninth Rank.

“`

“`

But Ninth Rank passing the Third Layer of the Black Tower in an instant? According to the standards left by the Moyu Tower Master, the difficulty of the Third Layer of the Black Tower was suited for those special Ninth Rank existences who had developed eighty to ninety million Spatial Layers, as well as simply those at Tenth Rank Life.

“`

“`

Among the Ninth Rank Life, even for those who had nearly a hundred million Spatial Layers, crossing the Third Layer of the Black Tower would require extreme caution, continuous movement among the numerous Spatial Layers, evading the omnipresent pressure.

“`

“`

However, Lin Yuan?

“`

“`

Stone Statue didn’t know how to describe Lin Yuan’s pace of conquering the tower, because the other party didn’t spend any time at all; just one step took him to the ‘finish line.’

“`

“`

“How many Spatial Layers did he occupy?”

“`

“`

The Stone Statue began to rewind the footage, slowing down the step Lin Yuan took.

“`

“`

In the main space, Lin Yuan simply took one step, but in that instant, he occupied countless layers of space, at the very least, over five hundred million Spatial Layers were under his control at the same time.

“`

“`

It was precisely because of this that Lin Yuan could easily cross from the starting position to the finish line of the Third Layer of the Black Tower.

“`

“`

“This monster…” Stone Statue Shen Ji shook his head repeatedly.

“`

“`

Perverted.

“`

“`

Too perverted.

“`

“`

If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, Stone Statue Shen Ji would have never believed that such a perverted being like Lin Yuan could exist within a mere universe.

“`

“`

Developing over five hundred million Spatial Layers, while indeed heard of during the glorious days of the Magic Jade Tower, how much time has passed since Lin Yuan stepped into Ninth Rank?

“`

“`

Swoosh.

“`

“`

The figure of Stone Statue Shen Ji appeared at the ‘finish line’ of the Third Layer of the Black Tower. As the guardian of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, he had the authority to appear on any layer.

“`

“`

“Kid, among the Ninth Rank Lives who have passed the Third Layer, you are the fastest.” Stone Statue Shen Ji forced a smile and said.

“`

“`

The reason he limited the scope to Ninth Rank was because among the lives that had passed the Third Layer of the Black Tower, there were those at Tenth Rank, Eleventh Rank, and even Twelfth Rank Ultimate Beings.

“`

“`

“Would you like to try the Fourth Layer?” Stone Statue Shen Ji suddenly asked.

“`

“`

If it were any other Ninth Rank Life, having passed the Third Layer, he definitely wouldn’t have asked this question.

“`

“`

The Third Layer of the Black Tower mainly targeted Tenth Rank Lives, and only a small part of Ninth Rank who had developed nearly a hundred million Spatial Layers were expected to pass.

“`

“`

The Fourth Layer of the Black Tower, however, was targeted at those at the peak of Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank Lives. The Fifth Layer targeted Eleventh Rank Lives who had a complete understanding of the Rule of Time. The Sixth Layer targeted those Eleventh Rank Lives that started to integrate the Rule of Time with Space Rules.

“`

“`

As for the Seventh Layer, Eighth Layer, and Ninth Layer of the Black Tower… only Twelfth-Rank Lives, the Supreme Beings, could pass through.

“`

“`

The leap from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank is a significant transition, a qualitative change. Ninth Rank Lives, even if they have developed a billion Spatial Layers, tens of billions, would not be able to cross the Fourth Layer of the Black Tower.

“`

“`

The test of the Fourth Layer is not about the occupation of Spatial Layers.

“`

“`

“Alright.” Lin Yuan nodded, eager to see what the Fourth Layer of the Black Tower was like.

“`

“`

It would be great if he could pass, and there’d be no loss if he couldn’t.

“`

“`

Swoosh.

“`

“`

Lin Yuan vanished, reappearing at the Fourth Layer of the Black Tower.

“`

“`

“The test of this layer is…” Lin Yuan’s face was slightly solemn, “Time?”

“`

“`

With his current understanding of the Rule of Time, he instantly realized that in different areas of the Fourth Layer, the speed of time flow was changing.

“`

“`

In some areas, time was accelerating, in some, decelerating, and in others, it was paused.

“`

“`

There were even a few areas where time flow was slowly reversing.

“`

“`

“Let’s see.”

“`

“`

After carefully observing for a moment, Lin Yuan took his first step.

“`

“`

…

“`

“`

Outside the Black Tower, witnessing this scene, Stone Statue Shen Ji’s expression subtly changed, “This kid has a profound mastery in the Rule of Time too?”

“`

“`

Stone Statue Shen Ji was numbed. The Rule of Time, Ninth Rank Lives can indeed feel time fluctuations, but that’s far from true comprehension.

“`

“`

Generally speaking, only Tenth Rank Lives begin to feel the Rule of Time, and now Lin Yuan, stepping forward bit by bit, was crossing regions warped by time, in the aspect of the Rule of Time, not inferior to those at the peak of Tenth Rank.

“`

“`

“What kind of cultivation method did this monster follow?”

“`

“`

Stone Statue Shen Ji wondered to himself, with such a short amount of time, even if he had entered a place with an exaggerated speed of time flow, it was impossible to have such progress.

“`

“`

Half an hour later.

“`

“`

Lin Yuan, with a cautious expression, after crossing the last area where time reverted back, finally reached the ‘finish line’ of the Fourth Layer of the Black Tower.

“`

“`

“I’ve made it through.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.
